commands.description: Log this device in to the dashboard: show a code on the dashboard, then type it here.
List the devices logged in to the dashboard as you.
Log out of one device by its id from /web sessions, or of every device with all.
Hide yourself from the dashboard's leaderboards, or show yourself again.
Print the DNS records that let players find this dashboard from the address they play on; check looks them up.
Apply web.yml and messages.yml now, without a restart. A web.yml with a problem isn't applied: the dashboard keeps running as it was, and the problems are listed.
Check web.yml without applying it, then how the dashboard is reached: its public address, the proxy in front, its DNS records and its map.
Add the settings web.yml lacks that this version has, with their defaults and explanations, keeping a backup and every line you wrote. --dry-run lists them first.
